comparison.definition: GitHub build workflow creation to the hosted reconciler completing exact artifact, ownership, generation, workload-readiness and served-revision verification
limitations: One before/after qualification sample, not an ordinary-traffic percentile
Both canaries changed workflow metadata; application source changed independently between them
The endpoints use the same hosted reconciliation completion semantics; no historical observer clock offset is subtracted

clock_accounting.policy: Keep external observations as raw records; do not combine an uncalibrated local timestamp with GitHub creation time for an exact comparative percentage
clock_accounting.http_date_precision: One second, plus request latency; clock comparison occurred after the canary

vm_resources.scope: Whole sampler interval around the canary, including pre-push and post-serving idle time; cgroups include background activity and page cache, and exclude hosted CI and Kubernetes node CPU

state_reads.scope: Three alternating read-only local invocations per binary against the same production status; excludes in-process connection reuse and state writes

controls.application_cli: Matching input digest installs the verified release directly; changed CLI sources consume the one shared build with checksum and input verification
controls.setup: Durable applied state selects tools; application-only changes omit host tooling, SSH and runner-registration setup; incomplete or failed reconciliation prepares full tooling
controls.state: Signed S3 requests reuse connections and retain conditional lease ownership, AES256 encryption and durable status updates; AWS CLI credential resolution remains as a fallback
controls.preflight: At most four workload permission checks run concurrently before mutation
controls.publication: Separate measured wait for production to contain the promoted commit; divergent history fails closed
controls.frontend_configuration: Both public build settings are fetched in one Doppler request and checked for empty or multiline values

validation: All 19 Bazel test targets plus generated-file validation through pipeline check-fast
Native S3 lease creation, expiry takeover, occupied lease rejection, conditional release and fail-closed error tests
Live read-only single-project and union-of-projects verification
Publication gate fixtures for behind, identical, ahead and divergent histories
Release checksum and attestation verified against the exact source digest and tag
Production activation and first-attempt frontend delivery
All Flux Kustomizations ready; exact frontend revision served; admission leases empty; transient sampler removed
